The chapter confirms the forest path was a deliberate corridor ('swept by some unseen hand') leading to the watchfort, and the humming of the channels indicates proximity to the next node. The transition from the forest containment system to the open world (watchfort) is explicitly depicted, advancing the contextualization of the network.
